record.question: A 5-year-old child shows persistent repetitive behaviors, difficulty in social interaction, and delayed speech. The most likely disorder is:
record.explanation: Answer B: Autism Spectrum Disorder. Persistent restricted/repetitive behaviors together with social-communication difficulties and delayed speech are characteristic features of autism spectrum disorder. Source/context note: A diagnostic evaluation is required; a brief vignette cannot establish diagnosis. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/autism/signs-symptoms/index.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
